description: Syndicat Mixte des Milieux Aquatiques et des Rivières de l'Aude: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte des Milieux Aquatiques et des Rivières de l'Aude. Coverage: Syndicat Mixte des Milieux Aquatiques et des Rivières de l'Aude. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Études d'aléas inondation par débordement de cours d'eau; Études d'aléas inondation par ruissellement; Repères de crues. Formats seen: ZIP, SHP, GEOJSON, WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
